---
title: "EC4362 - Covid confounder for the shift-share IV"
subtitle: "Regional Covid deaths (ONS) as the Covid control"
output: html_document
---

**Covid control: ONS Covid-19 deaths by area (regional).** One number per area (age-standardised mortality rates (ASMR)
per 100,000 in 2020, 2021, or both) is a *snapshot*. On its own it is absorbed by the area fixed effects, so we 
interact it with **year dummies**: areas hit harder by Covid are allowed to follow different paths over time.
We use 2020 deaths as the main version (measured before the end of the transition period, so post-Brexit migration
cannot affect it). 2021 and 2020+2021 are robustness checks. ONS covers England and Wales only, so these
regressions use **17 of the 20 areas** (no Strathclyde, Rest of Scotland, Northern Ireland).
Quarter-by-quarter interactions are too many parameters for 17 areas, so we use year dummies.

## 0. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
needed <- c("dplyr", "readr", "fixest")
missing_packages <- setdiff(needed, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_packages)) stop("Install these packages first: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
invisible(lapply(needed, library, character.only = TRUE))

project_dir <- dirname(getwd())     # repo root, since this notebook sits in notebooks/
panel_file  <- file.path(project_dir, "data/processed/residence_quarter_panel.csv")
ons_file    <- file.path(project_dir, "data/processed/ons_covid_by_area.csv")
output_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "outputs")
for (f in c(panel_file, ons_file)) if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Cannot find: ", f)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

panel <- readr::read_csv(panel_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
required <- c("residence", "year", "quarter", "pop", "share_birth_uk",
              "share_birth_other_europe", "share_birth_asia", "share_birth_rest",
              "mean_log_hourpay")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(panel))
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
if (anyDuplicated(panel[c("residence", "year", "quarter")])) stop("Duplicate region-quarter rows")

panel <- panel %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year), quarter = as.integer(quarter),
         time = year + (quarter - 1) / 4,
         period = paste0(year, "Q", quarter))      # one label per calendar quarter = quarter fixed effects
```

## 1. Shift-share variables (same construction as the IV notebook)

```{r iv-variables}
local_ratio <- panel %>%
  transmute(residence, year, quarter, time, period, mean_log_hourpay,
            ratio = 100 * (share_birth_other_europe + share_birth_asia + share_birth_rest) /
                    (100 * share_birth_uk)) %>%
  arrange(residence, year, quarter) %>%
  group_by(residence) %>%
  mutate(d_ratio = ratio - lag(ratio)) %>%      # change from the previous quarter
  ungroup()

national <- panel %>%
  group_by(year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(national_ratio = sum(pop * (share_birth_other_europe + share_birth_asia + share_birth_rest), na.rm = TRUE) /
                             sum(pop * share_birth_uk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(year, quarter) %>%
  mutate(g = national_ratio - lag(national_ratio), g_lag = lag(g))

baseline <- local_ratio %>%
  filter(year >= 2017, year <= 2019) %>%
  group_by(residence) %>%
  summarise(baseline = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

quarterly_iv_panel <- local_ratio %>%
  inner_join(baseline, by = "residence") %>%
  inner_join(select(national, year, quarter, g, g_lag), by = c("year", "quarter")) %>%
  mutate(shift_share = baseline * g, shift_share_lag = baseline * g_lag)
stopifnot(n_distinct(quarterly_iv_panel$residence) == 20)
```

## 2. Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# pick the coefficient whose name ends in d_ratio (fixest names the instrumented variable fit_d_ratio)
pick <- function(x) unname(x[grep("d_ratio$", names(x))][1])

# Section A: first stage and wage IV on the post-2020 sample (2021Q1 onward)
run_A <- function(label, data, ctl = "") {
  d <- data %>% filter(time > 2020 + 3 / 4, is.finite(mean_log_hourpay), is.finite(d_ratio),
                       is.finite(shift_share), is.finite(shift_share_lag))
  fs <- feols(as.formula(paste("d_ratio ~ shift_share + shift_share_lag", ctl, "| residence + period")),
              data = d, vcov = ~ residence)
  iv <- feols(as.formula(paste("mean_log_hourpay ~ shift_share_lag", ctl,
                               "| residence + period | d_ratio ~ shift_share")), data = d, vcov = ~ residence)
  list(row = data.frame(spec = label, areas = n_distinct(d$residence), n = nobs(fs),
                        fs_coef = unname(coef(fs)["shift_share"]),
                        fs_F = unname(coeftable(fs)["shift_share", "t value"]^2),
                        iv_coef = pick(coef(iv)), iv_se = pick(se(iv)), iv_p = pick(pvalue(iv))),
       fs = fs, iv = iv)
}

# Section B: pre/post-2021 interaction IV (two endogenous variables, two instruments), 2017 onward
make_B <- function(data) {
  data %>% filter(year >= 2017) %>%
    mutate(post2021 = as.integer(year >= 2021),
           d_ratio_post = d_ratio * post2021,
           shift_share_post = shift_share * post2021) %>%
    filter(is.finite(mean_log_hourpay), is.finite(d_ratio), is.finite(d_ratio_post),
           is.finite(shift_share), is.finite(shift_share_post), is.finite(shift_share_lag))
}
run_B <- function(label, data, ctl = "") {
  d <- make_B(data)
  m <- feols(as.formula(paste("mean_log_hourpay ~ shift_share_lag", ctl,
                              "| residence + period | d_ratio + d_ratio_post ~ shift_share + shift_share_post")),
             data = d, vcov = ~ residence)
  b <- coef(m); V <- vcov(m)
  n1 <- "fit_d_ratio"; n2 <- "fit_d_ratio_post"
  if (!all(c(n1, n2) %in% names(b))) stop("Unexpected coefficient names: ", paste(names(b), collapse = ", "))
  post <- unname(b[n1] + b[n2])
  post_se <- sqrt(V[n1, n1] + V[n2, n2] + 2 * V[n1, n2])      # includes the covariance
  data.frame(spec = label, areas = n_distinct(d$residence), n = nobs(m),
             pre = unname(b[n1]), diff = unname(b[n2]), post = post, post_se = post_se,
             post_p = 2 * pt(-abs(post / post_se), df = n_distinct(d$residence) - 1))
}

# Snapshot x year dummies. Returns the data with new columns and the formula terms.
#   from_year = first year that gets its own dummy; earlier years are the reference.
add_year_ints <- function(data, v, from_year) {
  yrs <- sort(unique(data$year)); yrs <- yrs[yrs >= from_year]
  for (y in yrs) data[[paste0(v, "_y", y)]] <- data[[v]] * (data$year == y)
  list(data = data, terms = paste0("+ ", paste0(v, "_y", yrs, collapse = " + ")))
}
```

## 3. Reference: baseline results, all 20 areas, no Covid control

```{r baseline-20}
base20_A <- run_A("Baseline, 20 areas", quarterly_iv_panel)
base20_B <- run_B("Baseline, 20 areas (incl. 2020)", quarterly_iv_panel)
base20_B2 <- run_B("Baseline, 20 areas (drop 2020)", filter(quarterly_iv_panel, year != 2020))
print(base20_A$row, digits = 3)
print(bind_rows(base20_B, base20_B2), digits = 3)
```

## 4. Covid control: ONS Covid deaths (regional) x year dummies, 17 areas

```{r ons-data}
ons <- readr::read_csv(ons_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("residence", "covid_asmr_2020", "covid_asmr_2021", "covid_asmr_2020_2021") %in% names(ons)))
ons_panel <- quarterly_iv_panel %>% inner_join(ons, by = "residence")      # drops the 3 Scottish / NI areas
cat("Areas with ONS data:", n_distinct(ons_panel$residence), "\n")
print(ons %>% select(residence, covid_asmr_2020, covid_asmr_2021), n = 20)
```

### 4a. Section A (first stage and wage IV, 2021Q1 onward)

2021 is the reference year in this sample, so the dummies cover 2022 onward.

```{r ons-section-a}
ons_vars <- c("2020 deaths" = "covid_asmr_2020", "2021 deaths" = "covid_asmr_2021",
              "2020-21 deaths" = "covid_asmr_2020_2021")
resA <- list(run_A("17 areas, baseline", ons_panel))
for (k in names(ons_vars)) {
  a <- add_year_ints(ons_panel, ons_vars[[k]], from_year = 2022)
  resA[[length(resA) + 1]] <- run_A(paste0("17 areas, + ", k, " x year"), a$data, a$terms)
}
tabA_ons <- bind_rows(lapply(resA, `[[`, "row"))
print(tabA_ons, digits = 3)
etable(lapply(resA, `[[`, "fs"), headers = tabA_ons$spec, keep = "^shift_share$")
etable(lapply(resA, `[[`, "iv"), headers = tabA_ons$spec, keep = "d_ratio")
```

### 4b. Section B (pre/post-2021 interaction IV), with and without 2020

Here the pre-2020 years are the reference, so the Covid snapshot gets its own dummy for each year from 2020 on.

```{r ons-section-b}
resB <- list(run_B("17 areas, baseline (incl. 2020)", ons_panel),
             run_B("17 areas, baseline (drop 2020)", filter(ons_panel, year != 2020)))
for (k in names(ons_vars)) {
  a <- add_year_ints(ons_panel, ons_vars[[k]], from_year = 2020)
  resB[[length(resB) + 1]] <- run_B(paste0("17 areas, + ", k, " x year (incl. 2020)"), a$data, a$terms)
  a2 <- add_year_ints(filter(ons_panel, year != 2020), ons_vars[[k]], from_year = 2020)
  resB[[length(resB) + 1]] <- run_B(paste0("17 areas, + ", k, " x year (drop 2020)"), a2$data, a2$terms)
}
tabB_ons <- bind_rows(resB)
print(tabB_ons, digits = 3)
```

## 5. Save results

```{r export}
readr::write_csv(bind_rows(base20_A$row, tabA_ons), file.path(output_dir, "covid_sectionA_results.csv"))
readr::write_csv(bind_rows(base20_B, base20_B2, tabB_ons), file.path(output_dir, "covid_sectionB_results.csv"))
message("Saved to: ", output_dir)
```
